items.a: Paid advertising on Google and Meta, with landing pages and tracking, judged by the cost of each qualified lead or sale rather than clicks.

items.q: Do I need a website or landing page before we start?
items.a: You need somewhere for people to land. We can build a landing page for the offer, with one action, tracking and UTMs set up before launch.

items.q: Is the ad budget included in your fee?
items.a: No. Ad spend goes to Google and Meta directly and is separate from our fee.

items.q: How often will I hear about performance?
items.a: We read cost per qualified lead every week, cut what is not converting and report on it in plain language.
